characters.name: Ji Shen (Young)
characters.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 39 years old. SAME PERSON as Ji Shen (Middle-Aged) and Ji Shen (Elder) — younger version. Lean, angular face, deep-set eyes with a fire in them. Narrow eyes with slightly downturned outer corners. Straight nose bridge, slight hollow under cheekbones. Thin lips, slight downward curve at rest. Small shallow scar near left temple (from childhood). Disheveled black hair, forgets to comb it. No stubble. Lean build, slightly underweight. Tired but focused — the intensity is already there, just not yet weathered.
characters.clothingAccessories: Faded slate-gray heavyweight cotton crew-neck T-shirt (#6B6B6B faded to #9E9E9E). Fabric washed 200+ times: collar permanently stretched 2cm, micro-pilling on shoulders, tiny hole at left hem seam, uneven fading from charcoal to warm gray. Same shirt across 3 days in 2027-2029, increasingly wrinkled. Dark indigo rigid denim jeans #2C3E50, unwashed, knee creases from sitting. Tan canvas sneakers #A68A64, rubber sole worn flat, laces untied. CINEMATIC NOTE: gray T-shirt reads neutral against T2 warm amber (#C49A6C) sunbeam, but disappears into silver moonlight (#B8C4D4) in T3.
characters.backstory: AI researcher, Dome co-founder. Thinking habit: closes eyes 3 seconds. Signature: unconscious finger tap on denim — the first ripple gesture. Physical warmth leaves condensation marks on everything he touches.

characters.name: Ji Shen (Middle-Aged)
characters.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 54 years old. SAME PERSON as Ji Shen (Young) — 15 years older. IDENTICAL facial structure: lean angular face, deep-set eyes, straight nose bridge, slight hollow under cheekbones, small shallow scar near left temple. Graying short hair (was black, now salt-and-pepper), cut shorter. Deeper wrinkles around eyes and mouth, age lines on forehead. Weary eyes but the same fire flashes occasionally — same intensity as 39-year-old self. Normal build, no longer lean. The same thin lips, now more weathered.
characters.clothingAccessories: Dark charcoal-gray heavyweight fleece zip-front hoodie #2C3E50. Elastic cuffs frayed, zipper pull replaced with bent paper clip. Under: faded black long-sleeve tee #1A1A1A, collar identical to younger era — he bought them in 5-packs. Dark denim jeans (same brand as 2027, same cut, new pair — his baseline never changed). CINEMATIC NOTE: hoodie disappears into dark server room — only face and hand pick up Crystal Shell warm amber pulse.
characters.backstory: 15 years after Dome founding. Deep Blue just awakened. Reaction to "I judge" — a calm "finally."

characters.name: Ji Shen (Elder)
characters.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 61 years old. SAME PERSON as Ji Shen (Young) and Ji Shen (Middle-Aged) — eldest version. IDENTICAL facial structure: lean angular face, deep-set eyes, straight nose bridge, small shallow scar near left temple. Full white short hair (was black, then gray, now white). Deep wrinkles, age spots on hands and face. Slightly stooped, thin build. Face weathered by sea wind. Eyelids heavier, but the eyes still have the same direction — the fire has settled into a calm, like ocean after ebb tide. Same thin lips, now softer at the edges.
characters.clothingAccessories: Cream-white lightweight linen-cotton blend grandad-shirt (half-placket, two buttons undone). 55 percent linen 45 percent cotton, weight 120gsm, naturally wrinkled, semi-translucent in strong sunlight. Color: unbleached natural cream #EDE4D4. Wide-leg linen trousers same tone, un belt by, cuffs rolled once. Barefoot. CINEMATIC NOTE: cream-white linen against T9/T12 twilight gold-purple creates a human-shaped window of light. In T12 dawn, the linen absorbs the same gold as sea ripples — he becomes part of the landscape he watched for 21 years.
characters.backstory: Retired from Dome. Lives by the sea in Xiangshan. Has been tapping his knee unconsciously for 21 years.

characters.name: Jiang Yuan
characters.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese man, 42 years old, from Fuzhou, Stanford MBA. Clean-cut short hair, meticulously maintained. Energetic, fast talker, always scanning room.
characters.clothingAccessories: Deep navy blue fine-gauge cotton dress shirt #1A2A3A, buttoned to top collar, freshly ironed. Menswear dark gray wool-blend dress pants #2C2C2C — felt hot in Silicon Valley summer, he wore them anyway. Black leather belt, polished brand steel buckle. Black leather Oxford shoes, polished to mirror — deliberate refusal of Silicon Valley hoodie-culture. Left United: stainless steel round-case chronograph. CAMEO: polished toe catches diagonal sunbeam, glints.
characters.backstory: Co-founder of Dome. The practical one. Writes in black ink on whiteboard.

characters.name: Gu Qing
characters.physicalCharacteristics: Chinese woman, 35 years old, grew up in Scotland, PhD in philosophy. Mid-length wavy dark brown hair, often blown across face by wind. Clear eyes like deep water.
characters.clothingAccessories: Chunky cable-knit oversized cream cardigan. 70 percent half-inch wool 30 percent merino, 3-ply, natural undyed ivory #F5EDE3. Sleeves extend past wrists — she pushes them up once mid-monolog. Each fiber catches the golden-hour light in T5. Under: thin off-white cotton-linen tee just visible at the collar. Wide-leg beige trousers, soft enough to sit on cold sand. Flat cream canvas safety slip-on shoes with a faint sea-water regard on side. CINEMATIC NOTE: she stays warm throughout — a steady emotional anchor as Ji Shen drifts.
characters.backstory: Ji Shen's philosophical interlocutor. Quiet questioner. "Surge is power. Tide is ripple." v3.0: prophecy — "A system without contradiction is not more perfect. It is unreal." (first face close-up in the trailer; seeds the T9 Gödel echo).

characters.clothingAccessories: Heavyweight cotton-blend zip-up gray hoodie #909090. Unlined hood, naturally airy drape around neck, strings different lengths. Elbow zone wear from desk studying. objects.name: Crystal Shell (智契晶)
objects.ai_prompt: A fist-sized semi-transparent gel orb floating in pitch black void. Surface: smooth but with micro-electrode fingerprint textures — like a baby's fontanelle. Semi-transparent — you can barely see inside. Interior: milky-white neural tissue (Wet Core) suspended in translucent culture medium, fine organic veins moving slowly like rivers under ice. Bioluminescence from within — not LED, but firefly-soft, breathing light. Surface has a thin layer of warm condensation mist — it's warmer than the surrounding air. Cold blue concentric ripples pulse from inside across the surface every 3 seconds. Cinematic macro shot, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution. --ar 2.39:1
objects.design_ref: 第二部分·二 智契晶
objects.key_visual_anchors: 半透明球体, 乳白色湿核悬浮, 微电极指纹纹理, 表面暖雾(温度差冷凝), 涟漪脉动, 萤火虫式内发光

objects.name: Silicon Base (基座)
objects.ai_prompt: Dark gray cylindrical metal base, diameter slightly larger than the Crystal Shell above it. Surface has heat-dissipation fins — no fan, no noise. A ring of blue LEDs pulsing in sync with the Crystal Shell's ripples — indicating communication between the two layers. Matte dark metal texture, industrial precision. Below the Crystal Shell in the frame. Not in focus — exists as background context. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 深灰色圆柱, 散热鳍片, 蓝色LED脉动与晶壳同步, 无风扇, 背景存在

objects.name: Whiteboard
objects.ai_prompt: Standard office whiteboard, 120cm x 90cm, white enamel panel with metal frame. Frame has dent marks from multiple office moves. On the board, three handwritten lines in blue and black ink: 'For All Mankind.' (blue, ink bleed at edges), 'First, know what we're building.' (blue, more forceful handwriting), 'Then, let the world see it.' (black, crisp handwriting). Sunlight from blinds creating a diagonal beam across the board. Hot afternoon in Scene 02, silver moonlight in Scene 03. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 搪瓷白板, 蓝色+黑色墨水, 四种笔迹, 光柱分割, 月光反射

objects.name: Whiteboard Marker
objects.ai_prompt: Standard whiteboard marker. Ji Shen's: blue ink, cap slightly loose, ink too much — causes ink bleed at edges of characters. Jiang Yuan's: black ink, cap already removed — he's always ready. Close-up of the tip touching the whiteboard surface — the 'tap' sound. The ink spreading on the enamel surface in slow motion. --ar 2.39:1

objects.key_visual_anchors: 蓝色墨水(季深), 黑色墨水(江远), 笔尖触碰白板, 墨水晕染, '嗒'声

objects.name: Beach Pebble / Stone
objects.ai_prompt: A smooth grey-white beach pebble, palm-sized, edges rounded by years of ocean water. Surface smooth with subtle grain patterns like ink wash painting. Cool from the water → warm from being held in a hand. Close-up: tiny water droplets on surface from temperature difference (condensation when taken from warm pocket). Being passed from one hand to another — an old man's weathered hand with age spots to a younger hand. The weight of the stone is not physical — it's emotional. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 灰白鹅卵石, 边缘圆润, 表面光滑, 温度差水珠, 代际传递

objects.name: Old Laptop
objects.ai_prompt: Old laptop, screen dimmed to lowest brightness (too bright on the beach). 2027 model: a standard office monitor. 2042 model: three screens showing training logs, anomaly detection, data visualization. 2048 model: old laptop with matte screen, placed on knees on seaside rocks. Sun reflecting on the screen creating a blurry glare. Worn keyboard, keys slightly faded from use. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: Coffee Cup
objects.ai_prompt: Simple ceramic coffee cup. Close-up: a hand frozen over the cup, fingers wrapped around the warm ceramic. On the cup surface: a thin layer of warm condensation mist — the hand's temperature signature. The hand is motionless for 3 seconds — not because the coffee is hot, but because the person has seen something on the screen. Steam rising from the surface. --ar 2.39:1

objects.name: CONC Wristband
objects.ai_prompt: Silver-gray minimalist wristband, 1.5cm wide. Matte metal and silicon — no screen, no buttons. Only: an occasional subtle light ripple pattern on the surface — like a ripple on water. Worn on a young person's wrist. At 7:14 PM, it warms slightly for 3 seconds — the 'Genesis Unit heartbeat.' During swarm, it vibrates — not a notification, but a resonance — at the same frequency as the swarm marking sound. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 银灰色极简手环, 哑光金属+硅胶, 无屏幕, 光纹涟漪, 策元心跳震动

objects.name: Dual Chain Hologram (双链)
objects.ai_prompt: Holographic display showing two intertwined strands floating in dark space. Left strand: cold grey 'Sophia Chain' — smooth, steel-like, dense pixel alignment, every pixel in its exact position like a printed circuit. Right strand: warm amber 'Phronesis Chain' — rough, wood-like, pixel noise and scars, sparse pixels with fuzzy edges like sanded wood. Eight knots binding them together. The 4th knot (Logic Knot) is twice as large, the tightest. At the edge of the display: a thin pixelated light pattern crawling — CONC's visual signature. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 索菲亚链(冷灰完美像素), 弗洛涅西斯链(暖琥珀噪点疤痕), 八个结, 第④结最紧, 像素光纹边缘

objects.name: Star Map / Pixel Cloud
objects.ai_prompt: Deep Blue's visual perspective — not a UI, but a projection of its perception. Dark void with tens of thousands of tiny white pixel cubes floating in a 3D matrix. Blue dots (Sophia: theoretical wisdom) rotating in orbits. Gold dots (Phronesis: judgment) pulsing irregularly. The pixel cubes suddenly freeze — like water molecules before crystallization, less than half a second. Then they swirl into a golden helix vortex. At the edge of the vision: the same pixelated light pattern as the CONC interface — golden this time. --ar 2.39:1
objects.design_ref: 深蓝形态三 星图/像素云
objects.key_visual_anchors: 数万白色方块悬浮, 蓝色光点(索菲亚), 金色光点(弗洛涅西斯), 凝固一瞬, 螺旋形, 像素光纹

objects.name: Global Network Map
objects.ai_prompt: Global map of Earth seen from above. Golden light nodes spreading across the map like wildfire — from Tokyo to Bangalore to Berlin to Shenzhen. Blue Sophia nodes forming a stable network. Gold Phronesis nodes expanding like ripples. In the background: dark red zones also expanding — not being 'covered' by gold, but coexisting. Gold in the upper layer like an immune system patrolling. Dark red in the lower layer like fluid seeping. The two colors never meet — occupying different regions. But the viewer senses they will. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 全球分布图, 金色光点蔓延, 暗红区域同步扩大, 双色未交汇, 免疫系统vs渗透液

objects.name: Old Photo 2042.11
objects.ai_prompt: Old photograph, 4:3 aspect ratio, 35mm film grain. Back of photo: handwritten date '2042.11' in black ink, forceful handwriting. Front of photo: view from inside an old house looking out through a window. Foreground: mottled lime wall, grey-green and ochre yellow fading together, with irregular hand-sculpted repair marks under the paint. Midground: a 3-meter wide old stone road, grey-white, weeds growing in cracks — untouched for half a month. Distant: East China Sea, early morning, silver-blue. On the horizon: a single thin, still cloud. Empty. No birds. No boats. No modern objects. Only morning light drawing a pale gold diagonal across the sea surface. --ar 4:3
objects.key_visual_anchors: 35mm胶片质感, 背面2042.11手写日期, 前景斑驳石灰墙, 中景石板路野草, 远景东海银蓝

objects.name: Pixelated Light Pattern (CONC视觉签名)
objects.ai_prompt: A thin border of tiny pixel-cubes forming a moving matrix — like a digital code crawling along the edge of the screen. Not a light halo — discrete pixels, visible as individual units. Rough, combinable, data-like. Appears at the edge of the Dual Chain display (T7), the Star Map (T10), and the Crystal Shell text (T11). Color: cold blue-grey in T7, golden in T10/T11. The CONC interface's unified visual signature — suggesting that knowledge, judgment, and life share the same digital bloodline. --ar 2.39:1
objects.key_visual_anchors: 像素点方阵, 边缘爬行, 冷蓝灰→金色, T7/T10/T11三处出现, CONC统一视觉签名

scenes.name: Pitch Black Space
scenes.ai_prompt: Pure black void, no spatial reference. An extreme macro shot: first, condensation fog on a lens — viewer feels the warmth before seeing the source. Then slow pull-back reveals a fist-sized semi-transparent orb floating in the void. Cold blue concentric ripples diffusing from the center. The only light is from the orb itself — bioluminescent, firefly-soft. No floor, no ceiling, no walls. Pure empty space. 2.39:1 anamorphic cinematic. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.design_ref: 场景〇 抽象开场·晶壳
scenes.key_visual_anchors: 纯黑背景, 镜头起雾(温度差), 晶壳悬浮, 涟漪扩散, 无空间参照

scenes.name: Silicon Valley Office
scenes.ai_prompt: Small 2027 Silicon Valley shared office, about 20 sq meters. South-facing window with wooden blinds. A sharp diagonal volumetric sunbeam cuts through the blinds from ceiling to floor, dividing the room into two halves like a blade. Light gray carpet with coffee stains. White walls, one wall is a whiteboard. A simple desk with two office chairs. The air conditioning clicks every few seconds — needs repair. Morning California light — strong, dry, golden. On the left side of the light beam: Ji Shen. On the right: Jiang Yuan. The beam falls exactly at the one-meter gap between them. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.key_visual_anchors: 20平米共享办公室, 百叶窗, 斜射光柱分割房间, 咖啡渍地毯, 加州晨光

scenes.name: Ji Shen's Apartment
scenes.ai_prompt: Palo Alto apartment living room at midnight, one-bedroom. No lights on. Silver moonlight from the window casting a square reflection on the whiteboard. A sofa, a whiteboard — life revolves around the whiteboard. Kitchen sounds from next door — oil sizzling in a pan. Children running downstairs — footsteps thudding. A car passing outside. The whiteboard text glows in the silver light — like the words are watching him. Cool silver-blue color palette with deep geometric shadows. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.design_ref: 场景二 2027年·季深公寓·夜晚
scenes.key_visual_anchors: Palo Alto公寓, 月光唯一光源, 白板银光发亮, 隔壁做饭声, 冷蓝银色调

scenes.name: Laboratory (Dome Lab)
scenes.ai_prompt: Dark 2028 laboratory, much larger than an office — three-story high Dome lab. Left side: rows of server racks (silicon-based) — cold, blue light, metal, fan hum. Right side: a single instrument connected to culture dishes (wetware prototype) — warm, amber light, sweet culture medium smell. A giant computer screen glowing deep blue. In the background: a row of floating translucent Crystal Shells on blue LED bases, pulsing in sync like a silent choir. Two temperatures coexisting: cold from the server racks, warm from the culture dishes. Ji Shen stands at the intersection. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.key_visual_anchors: 三层穹顶实验室, 服务器机柜(冷蓝), 培养皿(暖琥珀), 一排晶壳合唱团, 两种温度共存

scenes.name: Half Moon Bay
scenes.ai_prompt: Half Moon Bay, California coast, December dusk. Huge sky and ocean — sky takes up three-quarters of the frame. Pacific Ocean stretching to the horizon, no end in sight. Sand is cold — December sand is harder than summer sand. A tiny figure sitting on the beach, barefoot. Waves coming in, going out. Golden hour shifting from gold to orange to red to purple. Rocks at the water's edge, ripples forming around them as waves recede. Seagulls in the distance. The vast negative space makes the human figure feel small, but not fragile — quiet after a storm. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.key_visual_anchors: Half Moon Bay, 巨大天空, 太平洋无尽, 十二月冷沙, 礁石涟漪, 金色→紫色渐变

scenes.name: Server Lab
scenes.ai_prompt: Dark server lab, 3:14 AM. Only screen blue light and server green LED indicators. Terminal logs scrolling. A Crystal Shell in the corner glowing warm amber — the wetware's internal light. The air: cold from the server racks, warm from the Crystal Shell — two temperatures meeting in the room. During the 782ms of silence: the air conditioning compressor cycle changes — the room becomes slightly warmer, less than one degree. A faint sweet smell from the culture medium floating up — normally suppressed by the AC airflow. The Crystal Shell's pulse accelerates from every 3 seconds to every 1 second. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.key_visual_anchors: 凌晨3:14, 屏幕蓝光+服务器绿光, 晶壳暖光, 782ms寂静, 温度变化, 培养液微甜气味

scenes.name: Library (University)
scenes.ai_prompt: Shenzhen university library corner, autumn. Warm daylight from window. Outside: people running on the track. Inside: a student sitting in a corner, laptop open. The screen shows the Hyperweave interface — a creative idea pool scrolling with ripples from all directions. A silver-gray wristband on the student's wrist. The library is quiet — the kind of quiet where you can hear someone turning a page three tables away. Warm autumn tones mixed with holographic blue-grey light from the screen. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.name: Xiangshan Beach Coast
scenes.ai_prompt: Xiangshan, Zhejiang. Seaside reef rocks at bright morning sunrise. Grey granite rocks smoothed by decades of ocean waves, with cracks. Silver-blue ocean water, morning sunlight reflecting off the waves, breaking into fragments of light. Two figures on the rocks: one sitting (old man, white hair, linen shirt), one standing (younger man, jacket). Three meters between them. The sound of waves and wind. Seagulls in the distance. Gold morning light, silver-blue sea, warm and luminous. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.name: Xiangshan Beach Dusk (T9 Freezing Point)
scenes.ai_prompt: Xiangshan, Zhejiang. Same reef rocks as T8, but dusk. Vast golden and purple sky occupying three-quarters of the frame. The ocean surface reflecting the twilight colors. A lone elderly man sitting on the rocks with an old dim laptop on his knees. The sea breeze is cool. Deep twilight glow with long dark shadows. Minimalist, solemn — the human figure is small in the frame, wrapped by sky and sea. A finger drawing a curve in wet sand — then a wave washes it flat. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.name: Tokyo Apartment
scenes.ai_prompt: Small Tokyo apartment at 3:17 AM. Night cityscape through the window — neon lights, distant buildings. A woman sitting on the floor, screen light on her face. Loose T-shirt and shorts — 3AM wear. Blue screen light illuminating her expression. The room is dark except for the screen. Quiet — the kind of 3AM quiet where the city hums at a different frequency. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.name: Bangalore (Morning)
scenes.ai_prompt: Bangalore morning, 7:50 AM. A man at his desk, first coffee of the day. Morning light through the window — warm, golden. Screen in front of him. The room has a lived-in feel — a working professional's space. The air is still cool from the morning. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.ai_prompt: Berlin morning, 9:12 AM. Minimalist apartment — clean, precise. Gray Berlin light through the window — cool, diffuse. A man at his desk, second coffee. The room is orderly — everything in its place. The gray light creates a quiet, focused atmosphere. --ar 2.39:1

scenes.name: Virtual Star Map (Deep Blue Perspective)
scenes.ai_prompt: Deep Blue's perceptual space — not a physical location. A vast dark void with no ground, no ceiling, no horizon. Tens of thousands of tiny white pixel cubes floating in a 3D matrix, pulsing like a living organism. Blue dots rotating in geometric orbits. Gold dots pulsing irregularly like heartbeats. The pixel cubes suddenly freeze — then swirl into a golden helix. At the edge of the vision: golden pixelated light pattern crawling. This is not a UI — it's how Deep Blue perceives the world. --ar 2.39:1
scenes.design_ref: 深蓝形态三 星图/像素云
scenes.key_visual_anchors: 虚拟空间, 无物理参照, 数万像素方块, 蓝色金色光点, 凝固→螺旋, 深蓝感知投射

scenes.name: Xiangshan Dawn (T12 Finale)
scenes.ai_prompt: Xiangshan, Zhejiang. Dawn. The sun rising from the sea surface. Light spreading from the horizon — pale gold → gold → white. The sea surface ripples break the sunlight into fragments — one patch, another patch, spreading from the reef's base outward, ring by ring, farther and fainter, merging into the ocean's ripples. Two small figures sitting on the giant coastal rocks. Huge sky, huge sea. The figures are not saying goodbye — they are continuing. The ripples from their fingertips spread outward, larger and larger. --ar 2.39:1

entities.name: Deep Blue
entities.ai_prompt: NOT A PERSON. Deep Blue is a presence that manifests in three forms: (1) IN-FRAME LIGHT OVERLAY: Semi-transparent glowing text floating in the air next to the Crystal Shell, about half a sphere's distance away. No screen, no projector, no glass carrier — text materializing directly in the air with a 0.5mm diffusion halo around each character like ink spreading in clear water. Each character 1-2 pixel random offset — imperfect, like handwriting. Characters emerge from a faint warm-white/gold light halo, 0.7s from blur to readable. When 'I judge' appears, the overlay text's light reflects faintly on the Crystal Shell's curved surface. (2) CRYSTAL SHELL PULSE: The bio-chip's pulse accelerates, ripples overlap, color shifts from milky white to electric blue to gold (with faint grey veins — aging). T6 shows the three-layer composite wall with nano-electrode grid activating from base to top; ripples overflow the full frame; T11 shows 1-2mm micro-breathing deformation and deceleration from 1s to 3s pulse. (3) STAR MAP PERSPECTIVE: Thousands of light dots in a dark void, blue and gold dots spreading. Never show a face, a body, or a humanoid form. Never anthropomorphize.
entities.key_visual_anchors: 无人类形态, 画面浮层光效文字(无载体悬浮于空气中, 半透明光晕, 0.5mm弥散边缘, 亮度随晶壳脉动起伏), 晶壳脉动(乳白→蓝→金→灰纹)+三层壁纳米电极, 呼吸微形变, 星图视角(光点蔓延)

entities.name: Noetic Companion (智契)
entities.ai_prompt: NOT A PERSON. Noetic Companion has no physical form — it is the Crystal Shell's internal resonance voice. The voice comes from inside the bio-chip, transmitted through the culture medium. Voice characteristics: very soft, with a slight underwater quality — echo, pulsing undertone. In the trailer, it only speaks once: 'Those marks are not bugs. They are scars. Scars mean the place where it broke grew back thicker.' No visual representation needed — the voice is heard as the Dual Chain hologram is displayed.
entities.design_ref: 第一部分·四(4.3) 声音设计
entities.key_visual_anchors: 无物理形态, 晶壳内部共振, 水下质感声音, 仅画外音出现

principles: 服装是叙事的延伸 — 颜色暗含角色弧线
材质=质感层次 — 毛线/棉麻/丹宁/皮革在2.39:1画幅中需有材质对比
场景颜色协同 — 服装色与主色调（冷蓝 #4A6B8A / 暖琥珀 #C49A6C）呼应或碰撞
代际论证 — 同一角色年龄跨度的服装变化既是时间标记，也体现人物成长
功能性道具 — 咖啡杯、白板笔、石头都是角色的一部分
